title: Data-efficient and weakly supervised computational pathology on whole-slide images
study_context: General weakly supervised whole-slide computational pathology method.
population_or_data: Cancer WSI tasks with independent cohorts and other image-domain variations; not cardiac allograft biopsies.
task: Classify WSIs from slide-level labels and localize diagnostically relevant regions.
method: Clustering-constrained attention multiple-instance learning with instance-level clustering.
main_findings: CLAM learns slide-level classifiers using slide labels and trainable attention pooling.
It produces class-specific attention heatmaps and was evaluated across several computational pathology tasks.
limitations: The benchmark tasks are not cardiac transplant rejection and do not establish local-domain performance.
does_not_establish: Attention heatmaps alone do not prove causal or faithful explanations of a prediction.
relevance_to_project: Defines the baseline architecture and its evidence boundary for this repository.
